title: Video-rate imaging of luminescent tumour cells in freely moving unshaved mice
protocol: Disperse colon26 cells stably expressing Nano-lantern in Hank’s solution.
Mix well the cell suspension using a 1-mL pipette tip with the pointed end cut off.
Subcutaneously transplant 100 μl of single cell suspension on the back of a mouse using a BD Lo-dose syringe 30G with a 30G needle.
Maintain mice on a 12-h light/dark cycle, with constant temperature and humidity.
Construct a light-tight box using an aluminium angle box and a shade curtain.
Attach a C-mount lens to a CCD camera.
Place the CCD camera in a small aluminium angle box inside a corrugated cardboard box.
Put the small aluminium angle box, CCD camera, and light source in the light tight box.
Reduce light power using an ND filter or similar device.
Attach a light diffuser to spread the light.
Turn the output end of the light source toward the roof of the shade curtain.
Set the CCD camera parameters for video-rate imaging.
Connect the exposure time out signals from the CCD camera to one of the oscilloscope’s channels using a BNC cable and a BNC branch connector.
Connect the exposure time out signal from the BNC branch connector to the multi-function generator’s trigger input.
Set the parameters of the multi-function generator to generate burst signals.
Choose square waveform for the signal generation.
Adjust amplitude settings from 0 to 5 V.
Set frequency to 15 Hz.
Specify cycle number as 1.
Set phase to -1 degree.
Ensure duty ratio is less than 50%.
Connect the output signals of the multi-function generator to another channel of the oscilloscope.
Adjust phase and duty ratio to prevent light leaking into another exposure time due to jitter.
Change frequency instead of adjusting duty ratio if needed for faster devices like LED power modulation.
Dissolve 8 μg of coelenterazine-h in ethanol.
Dilute the solution in 1× PBS.
Ensure the final concentration of ethanol is less than 20%.
Inject the coelenterazine-h solution intratumourally with a BD Lo-dose syringe 30G.
Place the mouse onto the stainless steel box in the light-tight box.
Tightly close the shade curtain.
Start video-rate imaging.
